entries.candidate: NTT Frankfurt 4 Data Center (FRA4), Voltastraße 15, 65795 Hattersheim am Main
entries.reason: NTT GDC's 2026 Sustainability Report (released 5 October 2026) lists FRA4 among its ISO 50001/14001 certified sites under operational control. Page 16 says heat recovered at one of its Frankfurt data centres, with Mainova and the City of Hattersheim, has been supplied to a local district-heating network since 2025, and page 21 names the 'Excess Heat Reuse in Frankfurt 4 Data Center' award. No allowed locator was found. Hattersheim is outside the Frankfurt municipal geoportal, the Hessen address and cadastre services are robots-disallowed (gds.hessen.de and gds-srv.hessen.de) or need authentication (inspire-sec.hessen.de, httpauth), and NTT's location page and 2024 fact sheet publish no coordinate. A city-centre or business-park point would not qualify. The site is not in the Atlas. Verifier note (worker 2, 23 October 2026): the report's 'Certifications (for sites under operational control)' list carries no date of its own, and 'About this report' scopes the report to FY25 (1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026); the captured PDF is also a post-release revision (ModDate 13 October 2026) with no archived copy of the 5 October version. The list therefore does not establish an in-window operating observation, and the 2026-10-05 status candidate is not relied on.
entries.reopen_condition: An allowed official locator for Voltastraße 15 or the FRA4 campus, such as an RP Darmstadt permit coordinate, a georeferenced Hattersheim Bebauungsplan or an operator-published coordinate, together with a dated NTT statement within 90 days of the update; the operating statement must itself be dated within the window (a dated NTT release or report statement about the site, or a page version bounded by an archived copy), not the undated FY25 certification list.
